title: XSQ-AST: An Explainable Audio Spectrogram Transformer Framework for Localising Synthetic Speech Artifacts
abstract: arXiv:2609.24770v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Localising artifacts in synthetic speech remains challenging, as most evaluation methods yield only global quality scores. This paper presents XSQ-AST, a framework that combines the SQ-AST speech quality model with WhisperX phoneme alignment and multiple saliency methods to produce temporally localised artifact diagnostics without model retraining. Saliency maps are projected onto continuous distributions via kernel density estimation and onto phoneme boundaries via phoneme-discretised saliency maps. A 40-participant listening test validated the framework across five perceptual dimensions. Attention Rollout, Attention Flow and an adapted GradCAM produced temporal distributions that correlated with listener highlights, with different methods best suited to different artifact types. An AUC-ROC analysis confirmed discrimination above chance.

translated_title: XSQ-AST：一个用于定位合成语音伪影的可解释音频频谱Transformer框架
translated_abstract: 定位合成语音中的伪影仍然具有挑战性，因为大多数评估方法只能给出全局质量分数。本文提出了XSQ-AST，这是一个将SQ-AST语音质量模型与WhisperX音素对齐和多种显著性方法相结合的框架，无需重新训练模型即可生成时间上定位的伪影诊断。显著性图通过核密度估计投影到连续分布上，并通过音素离散化显著性图投影到音素边界上。一项有40名参与者参与的听力测试在五个感知维度上验证了该框架。Attention Rollout、Attention Flow和改进的GradCAM生成了与听者标注相关的时序分布，其中不同方法最适合不同类型的伪影。AUC-ROC分析证实了其区分能力高于随机水平。
tldr: 本文提出XSQ-AST框架，将SQ-AST语音质量模型与WhisperX音素对齐及多种显著性方法结合，无需重新训练模型即可对合成语音伪影进行时间定位诊断，并通过40人听力测试和AUC-ROC分析验证了其与人类感知的一致性。
en_tdlr: XSQ-AST combines the SQ-AST speech quality model with WhisperX phoneme alignment and multiple saliency methods to temporally localise synthetic speech artifacts without model retraining, validated by a 40-participant listening test and AUC-ROC analysis.
